CHN Clinical Standards — General Testing Criteria
•  Regardless of cancer type in personal/family history:
     •  Individuals with a known pathogenic variant related to a hereditary cancer syndrome
     •  Individuals with previous limited genetic testing
•  To aid in systemic therapy and surgical decision-making
Above recommendations were adapted from the Contoso Health Network Genetic/Familial High-Risk Assessment guidance, version 2.2026.
